name: build-crew
description: A crew for building a scoped change: a coordinator holds the scope, an architect shapes the approach, builders implement it, tests are covered by their own seat, and an independent checker gates the result.
when_to_use: Use when we have an agreed change to implement and want the build, the tests, and the final check kept as separate seats.

routines.description: Plan one bounded change, implement it, run its checks, and repeat only while the evidence says the change is not yet right.
routines.name: Scoped build loop

routines.description: Re-read the finished diff and remove anything that does not serve the agreed change before the gate review.
routines.name: Minimal-diff pass
